scope: Targeted methods review for integration of public human native IPF scRNA/snRNA and spatial data; not an exhaustive systematic review.
evidence_policy: Primary original research and maintainer documentation. Review source-specific applicability and verification limits. Software documentation is not a universal biological or statistical guideline.

sources.title: Benchmarking atlas-level data integration in single-cell genomics
sources.citation: Luecken et al., Nature Methods, 2022; online 2021
sources.bounded_takeaway: Integration evaluation must measure both batch removal and biological conservation, including isolated/rare labels and label-free structure.
sources.applicability_limit: Benchmark implementations, hardware and parameter snapshots are historical; overall ranking is not a guarantee for current IPF states or modern package versions. Supervised methods benefit from cell-identity labels, which are not ground truth for unknown disease states.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Batch correction methods used in single-cell RNA sequencing analyses are often poorly calibrated
sources.bounded_takeaway: Pseudo-batch experiments test whether correction changes data when real batch effects are absent or small; several tested workflows introduced artifacts.
sources.applicability_limit: This evaluates calibration under a particular pseudo-batch design, not every real heterogeneous disease atlas. It does not supersede rare-cell or strong-batch benchmarks. Check the tested output and implementation before extrapolating to current scVI embeddings or Seurat IntegrateLayers.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: An integrated cell atlas of the lung in health and disease
sources.bounded_takeaway: The lung atlas combined raw counts with harmonized cell annotations, technical/clinical metadata and anatomical locations.
sources.applicability_limit: This is a healthy-reference and extended lung-atlas task; known rare cell types differ from unknown IPF states. Supervised labeling and annotation quality influence performance. Any pretrained/extended atlas must be audited for reserved donor inclusion.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Integrative analysis in Seurat
sources.bounded_takeaway: The official workflow supports a no-integration comparison and keeps original count/normalized data layers.
sources.applicability_limit: Software demonstrations explain usage, not clinical validity or donor-aware hypothesis testing. Conservatism is relative and does not ensure retention of every rare state. Record the actual installed version because current pages can change.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: scvi-tools introduction and SCVI.setup_anndata API
sources.bounded_takeaway: SCVI expects raw counts unless otherwise stated; normalized/log data are stored separately.
sources.applicability_limit: Providing a batch key does not establish identifiability when disease and study are confounded. Model-based differential expression is a separate inferential workflow, not a license to treat cells as independent donors. Feature selection and hyperparameters are context-dependent.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: scIB and scib-metrics evaluation APIs
sources.bounded_takeaway: The APIs separate biological-conservation metrics from batch-removal metrics.
sources.applicability_limit: Label-based scores inherit the labels' resolution and errors; good coarse-cell scores do not prove disease-state conservation. Batch mixing is inappropriate as a sole target for genuinely nonshared populations. Default composite weights are not universal scientific thresholds.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Systematic assessment of tissue dissociation and storage biases in single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq workflows
sources.bounded_takeaway: Dissociation, preservation and nuclei isolation altered cell recovery and expression profiles in a controlled comparison.
sources.applicability_limit: The principal controlled experiments used mouse kidney, so effect sizes and affected cell types cannot be transferred directly to human IPF. It demonstrates protocol bias, not a universally correct computational fix.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: A single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-Seq toolbox for fresh and frozen human tumors
sources.bounded_takeaway: Matched human tumor scRNA/snRNA recovered shared cell types at different proportions.
sources.applicability_limit: Human tumor tissues and matched acquisitions are different from unmatched public IPF cohorts; the historical CCA implementation is an example, not a current software recommendation.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression
sources.bounded_takeaway: Disease/perturbation inference must account for variation between biological replicates.
sources.applicability_limit: Not a proof that every cell-level model is invalid: mixed models and other replicate-aware procedures can address hierarchy. It does not establish one universally best method for every cell-state or distributional question.
sources.verification_note: Primary publisher search result supplied Results and Discussion;18 matched bulk/single-cell perturbation datasets plus experimental follow-up.

sources.title: A practical solution to pseudoreplication bias in single-cell studies
sources.bounded_takeaway: Cells from one individual are dependent subsamples.
sources.applicability_limit: This study favors mixed models and finds pseudobulk more conservative/less powered in its settings. It must not be cited as demonstrating that pseudobulk is the sole correct approach. Any model still requires identifiable design and enough independent individuals.
sources.verification_note: Primary abstract and detailed introduction/methods/conclusion retrieved.

sources.title: muscat detects subpopulation-specific state transitions from multi-sample multi-condition single-cell transcriptomics data
sources.bounded_takeaway: Multi-sample differential state analysis asks whether expression within a comparable subpopulation changes by condition.
sources.applicability_limit: A broad cell-type aggregate can mix true expression change with a shift in finer states. Selection of the aggregation unit must follow the biological estimand; missing/poorly captured state groups require eligibility handling, not invented zeros.
sources.verification_note: Primary publisher Results and Methods retrieved.

sources.title: Single-cell differential expression analysis between conditions within nested settings
sources.bounded_takeaway: Explicitly benchmarks nested single-dataset and atlas scenarios, runtime and negative-control calibration.
sources.applicability_limit: The IFN pathway evaluation favors t-test/MAST in ranking but uses acknowledged imperfect ground truth. Negative-control calibration is a distinct target. DREAM here means the repeated-measures model, not automatically an empirical recommendation to run every dreamlet configuration. Results are benchmark-specific.
sources.verification_note: Primary abstract, statistical framework, method descriptions, IFN pathway evaluation and negative-control benchmark retrieved.

sources.title: Efficient differential expression analysis of large-scale single-cell transcriptomics data using Dreamlet
sources.bounded_takeaway: Dreamlet has a current peer-reviewed publication as of this review date.
sources.applicability_limit: Functional recommendations below are supported by the official tutorial rather than claiming an independently reviewed benchmark result from this newly published full text.
sources.verification_note: Current peer-reviewed publication identity, date, DOI and authors verified in PubMed; publisher full-text open hit an authentication redirect.

sources.title: Dreamlet analysis of single cell RNA-seq; official package documentation
sources.bounded_takeaway: Aggregate original raw counts for each sample and cell type before the pseudobulk workflow.
sources.applicability_limit: These capabilities do not ensure a small IPF dataset has enough information to estimate all proposed effects. Library/sample preprocessing and precision weighting do not create independent donors.
sources.verification_note: Official documentation search extracts explicitly describe summing raw counts by sample and cell type and precision-weighted mixed models.

sources.title: Benchmarking integration of single-cell differential expression
sources.bounded_takeaway: Workflow rankings vary with sparsity, batch effects and the chosen discovery endpoint.
sources.applicability_limit: Prioritizing known disease genes does not establish calibrated donor-population inference.
sources.verification_note: Primary publisher text inspected; conflicting recommendations retained.

sources.title: Cell2location maps fine-grained cell types in spatial transcriptomics
sources.bounded_takeaway: A Bayesian model links a single-cell reference to spatial RNA counts while accounting for technical variation and sharing information across locations.
sources.applicability_limit: Method validation in several tissues does not establish accuracy for every fine IPF state, reference, chemistry or panel. A spatially colocated state pair does not establish direct cell contact, directionality or causal signaling.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Mapping human lymph node cell types to 10X Visium with Cell2location
sources.bounded_takeaway: Spatial input is untransformed, unnormalised mRNA counts.
sources.applicability_limit: The example is lymph node, not lung. Do not copy cells-per-location, detection or training settings as universal defaults. Latent embeddings and batch-corrected coordinates are not the unnormalised gene-count inputs described here.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: A comprehensive benchmarking with practical guidelines for cellular deconvolution of spatial transcriptomics
sources.bounded_takeaway: Benchmarks 18 methods with 50 real and simulated datasets, including variation in resolution, genes, spots and technology.
sources.applicability_limit: Rankings apply to the tested tasks and available ground truth/proxies, not every disease, rare state or future method. Real spot-based evaluations partly rely on marker correspondence where exact cell composition is unknown.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Understanding Xenium Outputs
sources.bounded_takeaway: Transcript tables contain cell assignment, feature, spatial coordinates and quality information.
sources.applicability_limit: Current defaults do not describe all older acquisitions. Audit the actual software version, segmentation method and output format. Cell-resolved acquisition does not eliminate assignment errors or establish biological cell contact.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Space Ranger Segmented Outputs
sources.bounded_takeaway: Current Space Ranger supports optional nucleus/cell segmentation for Visium HD.
sources.applicability_limit: A high-definition bin is not automatically a segmented biological cell. Older public HD packages may lack these newer segmentation outputs; do not infer availability from the latest documentation.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Spatial transcriptomic characterization of pathologic niches in IPF
sources.bounded_takeaway: Integrates six published lung scRNA datasets into a PF-ILD atlas; uses cell2location to connect expression signatures to Visium measurements.
sources.applicability_limit: The paper is a biological/application example, not a universal optimal integration recipe or proof of independent patient counts. Its broad basaloid/myofibroblast niche is already published, and inferred communication remains distinct from function.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

sources.title: Mapping spatially resolved transcriptomes in human and mouse pulmonary fibrosis
sources.bounded_takeaway: Uses Habermann GSE135893 as a single-cell reference for cell2location mapping of human Visium spots.
sources.applicability_limit: Published sample/donor regression and hyperparameters are task-specific; they should not be copied mechanically. Repeated blocks/sections are nested in donors, and their severity differences are cross-sectional rather than a longitudinal disease trajectory.
sources.verification_note: Primary published text or maintainer documentation checked; no empirical reproduction.

deduplication_note: Spatial review SP8 is the same HLCA source as R3 and is represented once.
source_review_boundaries: Selection used primary publisher/PMC/PubMed records and official documentation; inaccessible publisher pages were not treated as evidence of full-text review.
STAT05 verifies current Dreamlet publication identity only; functional recommendations use official tutorial STAT06.
No benchmark, source code execution, biological analysis, package installation or server task was performed.
project_recommendation_status: Proposed framework. Cohort choice, parameters, thresholds and selected integration method remain conditional on readiness checks and later empirical assessment.
